visibility.0: The landmark is occluded, outside the image, or its anatomical location cannot be judged reliably.
visibility.1: The landmark is visible and its coordinate has been checked by a human reviewer.
visibility.null: Automatic preannotation only; visibility has not been reviewed. This record is not ground truth.

annotation_policy: Keep all 28 positions, even when visibility is 0. Occlusion means visibility 0 even if an automatic prediction is anatomically plausible. Do not move an occluded point to a guessed location; retain its automatic coordinate only as a masked placeholder. Move a point and mark visibility 1 only when the target location is directly identifiable in the image. Do not infer visibility from heatmap confidence. Training and NME must mask visibility-0 points. The review UI converts remaining null visibility values to 1 only on an explicit per-image save after inspection; it records timestamp, edited indices, and occluded indices without requiring a typed reviewer identifier. Keep model confidence in a separate field. Test records require human review.
